Signed 6/19/2012; the Summary Page's 'Date of Report' box reads 6/18/2012. Column B here is headed 'Sum Total to Date' (older wording). itemized.page_subtotal_gates: This filing's schedules are the filer's own typed attachments and print NO per-page 'SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE' line - only one grand total at the end of each schedule. No page-subtotal gate could fire on any of the 11 itemized pages. The equivalent gate was applied to the two printed grand totals and BOTH pass exactly: Schedule A per-page sums 2160.00 + 10350.00 + 2355.00 + 9892.00 + 16642.50 + 15355.00 + 20650.00 + 5800.00 = 83204.50 = printed total; Schedule B per-page sums 23208.74 + 46389.32 + 16516.98 = 86115.04 = printed total.
itemized.escalation_note: PDF pages 3-10 are LANDSCAPE and had to be rotated: the first attempt (90 degrees counter-clockwise, the sign that worked on the other landscape filing in this chunk) came out UPSIDE DOWN, so this file needs -90 (CLOCKWISE) - the sign is per file, confirmed here. Each rotated page was then rebuilt as a composite of two column crops with the full-height black redaction bar removed, so the type would not be downsampled by the reader. Pages 11-13 (portrait) were read as 300 dpi half-page crops.
itemized.notes: THIRTEEN pages: p1 cover, p2 Summary Page, p3-p10 the filer's LANDSCAPE typed 'Schedule A - Itemized Contributions Received' (132 rows, ending with the printed Total on p10), p11-p13 the portrait typed 'Schedule B - Itemized Expenditures Made' (119 rows, ending with the printed Total on p13). No blank county Schedule A/B form pages are present - the attachments ARE the schedules. Cover: Mike Winder, SLCo Mayor, R; the JUNE 17 interim box is checked ('For the period ending June 18, 2008' as pre-printed on this 2008-vintage form template - the report itself is the June 2012 interim and the schedules are dated 6/18/2012); the amendment question is left UNANSWERED (neither Yes nor No ticked) despite the index label calling this an amendment; signed 6/19/2012. Cover street-address/phone/email blocks are county-redacted, and the Schedule A attachment's Address column is redacted with a full-height black bar - so donor_city/donor_state come from the attachment's own separate City and State columns and the (legible) Zip column is discarded per the privacy rule. The Schedule A attachment carries an explicit 'Inkind?' column: 14 contribution rows are marked, and the same golf-tournament donations reappear as 12 marked Schedule B rows plus the Mike Stangl HQ rent - in-kind items are booked on BOTH sides and DO count toward the printed totals. Two Schedule A rows are the form's own 'Aggregate Cash' lines rather than named donors (flagged needs_review). One filer typo retained verbatim: Waste Management's State cell reads 'TV' for a Houston address.
